evidence_limits: Text-only analyst-drafted accessibility, readability, response collection and feedback proposals. No browser, assistive technology, learner, expert or owner testing occurred.

records.scope_review_note: This is a topic-label crosswalk, not a determination that a particular learner has mastered the prerequisite.
records.wording_risk: Some learners may treat checking a few examples as proof of a universal statement.
records.learner_support_prompt_draft: Before giving your proof, decide what argument would cover every possible starting integer.
records.spoken_math_text_draft: Read n, n plus one, and n plus two as three consecutive whole numbers; distinguish the word every from example cases.
records.accessible_response_capture_spec: Collect a prose explanation plus optional structured factor evidence. Never certify an arbitrary proof from a checkbox.
records.non_answer_leading_feedback_draft: Testing several values can support a conjecture, but it cannot establish every case. Explain which property remains true when the starting number changes.

records.scope_review_note: This is a topic-label crosswalk, not a determination that a particular learner has mastered the prerequisite.
records.wording_risk: Coordinate axes, signs and the order of a pair can be confused when spoken.
records.learner_support_prompt_draft: Write the horizontal displacement first and the vertical displacement second; check which directions are positive.
records.spoken_math_text_draft: Read ordered pair as first coordinate x, second coordinate y. Read any minus sign aloud as negative, and read kilometres as the unit.
records.accessible_response_capture_spec: Offer two signed-number inputs with visible x/y labels and an announced unit; allow keyboard and screen-reader entry without color cues.
records.non_answer_leading_feedback_draft: The first entry records east or west, while the second records north or south. Check the named axes before you submit.

records.scope_review_note: This is a topic-label crosswalk, not a determination that a particular learner has mastered the prerequisite.
records.wording_risk: The phrase distance to the line could be mistaken for the length of a sloping side.
records.learner_support_prompt_draft: Sketch or imagine a line from each top vertex that meets the common base at a right angle.
records.spoken_math_text_draft: Read AB as line segment A B. Altitude means the shortest perpendicular distance to the line containing the base, even when the foot lies beyond the segment.
records.accessible_response_capture_spec: Offer a yes/no area comparison, numeric area with square-centimetre unit, and separate written justification; do not infer a valid proof from two flags.
records.non_answer_leading_feedback_draft: Identify the right angle to the base line. A tilted side is not necessarily the distance used in the area formula.

records.scope_review_note: This is a topic-label crosswalk, not a determination that a particular learner has mastered the prerequisite.
records.wording_risk: A curved cylinder wall can be confused with the whole closed cylinder surface.
records.learner_support_prompt_draft: Picture cutting only the side wall and laying it flat; decide which surfaces are not covered.
records.spoken_math_text_draft: Read radius and height in centimetres, and read pi as pi. Say curved wall or lateral surface rather than entire cylinder.
records.accessible_response_capture_spec: Provide a numeric area entry with square-centimetre unit and a separate choice of curved wall versus ends; present an optional text-only rectangle description.
records.non_answer_leading_feedback_draft: Only material touching the curved wall is needed. Decide what shape that wall would make if unfolded.

records.scope_review_note: This is a topic-label crosswalk, not a determination that a particular learner has mastered the prerequisite.
records.wording_risk: The row-to-row change in output may be mistaken for the slope without considering change in input.
records.learner_support_prompt_draft: Compare two rows using change in y divided by change in x; then check the entry at x equals zero.
records.spoken_math_text_draft: Read y equals m times x plus c, and pronounce any negative coefficient as negative. Read each paired x and y value in order.
records.accessible_response_capture_spec: Collect the linear equation as editable text for review plus separate numeric slope, intercept and target x; do not equate structured matches with grading algebraic prose.
records.non_answer_leading_feedback_draft: A change in output alone is not the rate per unit input. Compare the size of the corresponding input step.

records.scope_review_note: Separate product/curriculum review must decide if simultaneous-equation elimination is a Grade 9 SOF challenge or outside this learner tier.
records.wording_risk: Solving two simultaneous price equations may be beyond the single-equation material assumed for some learners.
records.learner_support_prompt_draft: Name the two unknown unit prices and use both orders as independent conditions, then verify each order.
records.spoken_math_text_draft: Read booklet price b and poster-card price c. Read each quantity and rupee total explicitly; keep units attached to prices.
records.accessible_response_capture_spec: Use two labelled unit-price inputs and a target total with rupee units, plus a prose method field for a non-automatic explanation review.
records.non_answer_leading_feedback_draft: Check each price against both original orders; a swapped label might seem plausible for one step but fail another.

records.scope_review_note: Separate product/curriculum review must decide whether determinant arguments and multi-step coordinate transforms are suitable as Grade 9 enrichment.
records.wording_risk: Sequential reflection, translation, signed determinants and absolute area can overload the central coordinate task.
records.learner_support_prompt_draft: Make a before-and-after table for each labelled vertex, applying the mirror step before the movement step.
records.spoken_math_text_draft: Read each ordered pair with x first and y second. Read reflection across the y-axis as changing the sign of x; describe signed versus unsigned area in separate words.
records.accessible_response_capture_spec: Offer three separately labelled vertex pairs and an area comparison; permit a base-times-height justification without requiring determinant terminology.
records.non_answer_leading_feedback_draft: Trace one point through the reflection and then through the translation. Apply the same sequence to the remaining points.
